clue.text: You are rude and rag is crude!

definitions.note: the solver of this puzzle, addressed directly

indicators.note: crude means rough and unrefined, so the preceding words are roughly rearranged

explanation.surface: An exclamation accusing someone of rudeness and calling a newspaper a crude rag.
explanation.walkthrough: 'You' is the solver: this puzzle appeared in the Guardian, so its readers are being addressed, and the joke is that they are being called rude while their paper is called a rag.
explanation.definitionFit: The person doing this crossword was, at first printing, someone who reads that particular daily newspaper.

clue.text: A device for lifting endlessly during depression is touching

indicators.note: during means within the span of, so one piece sits inside the depression

parts.note: a dent is a small depression in a surface

indicators.note: endlessly means the last letter of the lifting device is cut off

parts.note: a jack is a device for lifting a car

explanation.surface: A broken car jack sitting in a dent is somehow described as touching.
explanation.definitionFit: Adjacent things lie next to each other, sharing a border, so they are touching.

clue.text: A bitter lament, I suspect, in Bradshaw's work of fiction?

indicators.note: suspect as an adjective means dubious or not right, so these letters are to be rearranged

explanation.surface: A reader suspects that a sad lament appears in some novel by an author called Bradshaw.
explanation.walkthrough: Bradshaw's was the famous British railway guide; calling a railway schedule fiction is a jibe at trains that never run on time.
explanation.definitionFit: Bradshaw published railway schedules, and the question mark jokes that such a listing of departures is wishful invention.

clue.text: Sportsmanship in mountain climbing retained by one camping?

indicators.note: retained by means held inside, so the mountain sits within the other piece

parts.note: fairy is old slang for an effeminate, camp man, so one being camp

indicators.note: climbing in a down clue means the word for mountain reads upwards

parts.note: an alp is a high mountain

explanation.surface: Asks whether a camper keeps up good sportsmanship while climbing a mountain.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Camping' suggests tents but means behaving camply.
explanation.definitionFit: Playing within the rules and treating opponents justly is what sportsmanship consists of.

clue.text: See 18
Giving name to a couple of animals, last going first

indicators.note: the final letter of the two animal words is moved to the front

parts.note: a pony is one animal
a mouse is the second animal

explanation.surface: Someone names a pair of pets, with the last one to arrive being named first.
explanation.definitionFit: An eponymous figure is the one whose name is given to a book, place or thing.

clue.text: To speak of nobility is fruitless

indicators.note: to speak of signals that the word is said aloud and spelt differently

parts.note: a baron is a member of the nobility

explanation.surface: Talking about aristocrats is a waste of time.
explanation.definitionFit: Barren land or effort produces nothing, the same as fruitless.

clue.text: Hyperint?

parts.note: the word for an extremely intelligent person, hyperintelligent, is shown here cut to half its length

explanation.walkthrough: Hyperintelligent is too clever, and the clue gives it chopped by half: the phrase describes itself.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means irritatingly over-smart, and the clue shows a word for super-smart reduced by half.

clue.text: Pledge to pass on the inside?

definitions.meaning: to pledge is to promise formally to do something
slang for driving past another vehicle on the inside lane, the wrong side

explanation.definitionFit: To promise to do a job, and also British slang for overtaking on the nearside.

clue.text: This has keys to open taxi, evenly distributed

indicators.note: distributed means spread around, so the picked letters are rearranged
evenly picks the second, fourth and other even-numbered letters

explanation.surface: A passenger has the keys to unlock a taxi, shared out evenly among friends.
explanation.walkthrough: The even letters of 'to open taxi' are OPNAI; 'distributed' rearranges them.
explanation.definitionFit: A keyboard instrument has a row of black and white keys.

clue.text: More prepared to become martyrs in the end

indicators.note: in means placed within the other piece

parts.note: the rear is the back end
martyrs die for their cause

explanation.surface: People more ready to give their lives for a cause, eventually.
explanation.definitionFit: Readier is the comparative of ready, which means prepared.

clue.text: Collection of instant riches of magical significance

indicators.note: a collection of letters drawn together from the following words

explanation.surface: A heap of sudden wealth seems almost magical.
explanation.definitionFit: Tantric rites and texts relate to mystical, ritual magic in Hindu and Buddhist practice.

clue.text: I live to kiss a goat

parts.note: to be is to exist or live
X is the cross for a kiss at the end of a letter

explanation.surface: Someone confesses they exist only to kiss a goat.
explanation.definitionFit: The ibex is a wild mountain goat with long curved horns.

clue.text: Learner can upset many in old car when short and sweet

indicators.note: in means placed inside the shortened car
short means the last letter is cut off

parts.note: a banger is British slang for an old, battered car
L is the learner plate on British cars

indicators.note: upset means knocked into a new order, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: M is a thousand in Roman numerals, so many

explanation.surface: A learner driver upsets a whole crowd in an old car when out of fuel, and things turn sweet.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Old car' is the British slang word for a battered motor; 'upset' gives ANC, and 'many' is the Roman thousand, a crossword convention.
explanation.definitionFit: Blancmange is a set milk pudding, a dessert or sweet.

clue.text: See 3
Sound girl, so smartly dressed?

indicators.note: sound means the word is heard rather than spelt

parts.note: Natalie is a girl's name

explanation.surface: A girl with a sound mind asks whether she is very well turned out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sound' looks like praise for the girl but signals a homophone.
explanation.definitionFit: Nattily means in a neat, smart and fashionable way, usually of dress.

clue.text: Paint cheese without semicircle, half of cheese

indicators.note: without means the semicircle shape is removed

parts.note: Gouda is a Dutch cheese
the capital D is shaped like a semicircle

indicators.note: half of means only the first three letters of the word are taken

explanation.surface: A strange recipe for paint made of cheese.
explanation.definitionFit: Gouache is an opaque watercolour paint.

clue.text: Indo-American girl to leave homeland

parts.note: Goa is a state in India, so Indian
broad is American slang for a woman

explanation.surface: A girl of Indian and American heritage leaves her native land.
explanation.definitionFit: Going abroad means travelling away from one's own country.

clue.text: Athletic man's weight behind gun lobby?

indicators.note: behind means the weight comes after the earlier pieces

parts.note: Charlton Athletic is a London football club, so the club's first name
man's read as man is gives he's
a ton is a unit of weight

explanation.surface: Someone asks which footballer's bulk is backing a firearms pressure group.
explanation.walkthrough: The actor was president of America's National Rifle Association, so a figurehead of the gun lobby.
explanation.definitionFit: The Hollywood star led the National Rifle Association, embodying that firearms pressure group, hence the question mark.

clue.text: Compose a clue about films, not entirely about Universal

indicators.note: compose means put together, so the letters are arranged afresh
not entirely means the last letter is dropped

parts.note: cinema stands for films as an art form

explanation.surface: A setter is told to write a clue about films that is not wholly about one studio.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Compose' mixes A CLUE with CINEM (cinema without its last letter); 'about' twice merely links. Universal looks like the film studio.
explanation.definitionFit: Ecumenical means worldwide or general, especially of the whole Christian church.

clue.text: As bears arms finally, something passed round

indicators.note: round means surrounding, so one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: urine is something passed from the body

indicators.note: finally picks the closing letter of the word

explanation.surface: A bear-like weapon finally passes around something.
explanation.definitionFit: Ursine means like or relating to bears.

clue.text: Compound that is confining revolutionary Carthaginian queen

indicators.note: confining means enclosing, so one piece holds the other

parts.note: i.e. abbreviates id est, that is

indicators.note: revolutionary means turned round, so the name is read backwards

parts.note: Dido was the legendary queen of Carthage

explanation.surface: A substance imprisons a rebel queen of ancient Carthage.
explanation.definitionFit: An iodide is a chemical compound of iodine.

clue.text: Post is the preserve of the auditor

indicators.note: the auditor is the listener, so the word is as heard

parts.note: jam is a fruit preserve

explanation.surface: A doorpost is the conserve belonging to a listener.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Auditor' looks like an accountant but means a hearer.
explanation.definitionFit: A jamb is the upright post at the side of a door or window.

clue.text: State credentials to get a house

parts.note: ID is identification, one's credentials

explanation.surface: Show your papers to the state to be given a home.
explanation.definitionFit: Idaho is one of the states of the USA.

clue.text: Father collects shiner, being craven traitor

indicators.note: collects means gathers in, so one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: dad is father
a star shines

explanation.surface: A father picks up a black eye and is called a cowardly turncoat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Shiner' suggests a black eye but is just something that shines.
explanation.definitionFit: A dastard is an old word for a sneaking, dishonourable coward.

clue.text: Game beast, but not popular, who wasn't allowed to join in games

definitions.text: who wasn't allowed to join in games

parts.note: RU is rugby union

indicators.note: but not means the popular word is removed

parts.note: a dolphin is a sea creature
in means popular or fashionable

explanation.surface: An unpopular animal hunted for sport was excluded from playing games.
explanation.walkthrough: In the Christmas song the other reindeer never let the red-nosed one join in any reindeer games.
explanation.definitionFit: The song says the red-nosed reindeer was barred from the other reindeers' games.

clue.text: Path right back from an organ

indicators.note: back means the pieces are read in reverse order

parts.note: a lane is a narrow path or road

explanation.surface: Taking the path straight back from an organ.
explanation.definitionFit: Renal means of or relating to the kidneys, which are organs.

clue.text: Cold figure that made love in valley

indicators.note: in means placed within the valley

parts.note: a dell is a small wooded valley

indicators.note: made means formed into something new, so the word is rearranged

parts.note: love is zero in tennis, O

explanation.surface: A chilly statue was what made love down in the valley.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cold' and 'figure' read like a chilly statue, but together they describe a grim statistic; 'made' gives ATHT.
explanation.definitionFit: The number of people killed is a stark statistic, a cold figure.
